notes.title: Soundtrack Release!
notes.notes:
The official soundtrack for Voxel Miner: Dwellers of The Deep is now released!
Don't worry it's[b] free for everyone![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2415300/Voxel_Miner_Dwellers_of_The_Deep_Soundtrack/

notes.title: Holiday Update!
notes.notes:
[h2][u][b]ADDITIONS / CHANGES[/b][/u][/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Added more sound effects[/b] [i](including laser sounds)[/i]
[*] [b]Added a tutorial panel animation[/b] [i](making it more obvious there is a tutorial when loading in)[/i]
[*] [b]Added ruin puzzle hints[/b] [i](some players were getting stuck trying to solve them)[/i]
[*] [b]Improved player movement animation[/b]
[*] [b]Added loading screen tips[/b]
[*] [b]Reworked teleporter triggers[/b] [i](they no longer teleport you back when staying still on them)[/i]
[*] [b]Removed biome sounds and effects while in ruins[/b]
[*] [b]Improved some upgrade icons[/b]
[*] [b]Added fireflies[/b]
[*] [b]Added some holiday cheer to the main menu[/b]
[*] [b]Added a limited-edition holiday accessory[/b]
[*] [b]Added some holiday cheer to dwellers[/b]
[*] [b]Other minor bug fixes[/b]
[/list]

[i]Feel free to contact me in the [b]#voxel-miner[/b] channel in our discord server for any support/questions!  [url=https://discord.gg/bUJnbaXSVx]Discord Server[/url][/i]

notes.title: The STORY Update!
notes.notes:
[h2][u][b]ADDITIONS / CHANGES[/b][/u][/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]added XP loot boxes[/b] [i](can be found in ruins like the normal loot boxes)[/i]
[*] [b]added 40 notes that can spawn in ruins[/b] [i](lore! uncover the mysteries of the virus, and why this once flourishing cave has been abandoned, and consumed by a devastating virus)[/i]
[*] [b]added notes menu to the radial menu[/b] [i](here you can view your discovered notes, and read through them)[/i]
[/list]

Feel free to contact me in the [b]#voxel-miner[/b] channel in our discord server for any support/questions!  [url=https://discord.gg/bUJnbaXSVx]Discord Server[/url]

notes.title: Accessories Update
notes.notes:
[h2][u][b]ADDITIONS / CHANGES[/b][/u][/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]added a customization menu[/b] [i](replaced the textures button)[/i]
[*] [b]implemented accessories[/b] [i](this will allow you to add accessories to your player!)[/i]
[*] [b]added crown accessory[/b] [i](currently the only one available, more soon to come!)[/i]
[/list]

[i]Im going to be going on vacation for a week, but I am bringing my laptop to continue updates, they might be smaller ones during this period, but I'm back on 6/27.  Feel free to contact me in the [b]#voxel-miner[/b] channel in our discord server for any support/questions in the meantime!  [url=https://discord.gg/bUJnbaXSVx]Discord Server[/url][/i]

notes.title: Community Update
notes.notes:
[h2][u][b]ADDITIONS / CHANGES[/b][/u][/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]added news panel[/b]
[*] [b]added credits page[/b] [i](huge thanks to everyones support so far!)[/i]
[*] [b]increased dropoff odds[/b] [i](changed on 6/16)[/i]
[*] [b]added option to lower texture quality[/b] [i](hopefully helps memory issues caused by low ram)[/i]

[/list]

[/list]

[i]Im going to be going on vacation for a week, but updates will resume once I'm back! (on 6/27)  Feel free to contact me in the [b]#voxel-miner[/b] channel in our discord server for any support/questions in the meantime!  [url=https://discord.gg/bUJnbaXSVx]Discord Server[/url][/i]
